question.text: An option on crude oil has a premium of Rs 150 and intrinsic value of Rs 0. This option is:

answer.text: Either ATM or OTM — its entire premium consists of time value
ITM because the premium is positive
Deep ITM with no time value
Cannot be determined without more information

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, ATM and OTM options have zero intrinsic value — the entire premium is time value. The workbook ATM example similarly shows zero intrinsic value with a time-value premium. The Trap: A positive premium does not imply ITM; OTM options can carry positive time value before expiry. Deep ITM options usually carry minimal time value. Note: Zero intrinsic value uniquely identifies an ATM or OTM option; the Rs 150 premium here is purely time value.
